about.zh: 你递给 AI 一张图，AMB 自动抠出人物，只重画人物以外的地方：AI 在提示词里写新场景，人物原样留下。人物边缘留几像素一起重画，让新背景和人物接得上。
about.en: From a picture you hand the AI, the character is cut out automatically and everything else is drawn anew: the prompt says the new scene, the character stays as it was. A few pixels of its edge are redrawn too, so it sits in the new scene.

source.zh: 常见的“抠图换背景”做法：inspyrenet-rembg 抠人物，反选成背景，用 ComfyUI 自带的局部重绘节点只重画背景
source.en: The common cut-out-and-replace-the-background way: inspyrenet-rembg finds the character, its inverse is the background, ComfyUI's own inpainting nodes redraw only that

after: Write the new scene in the prompt and keep the character's own words (who, hair, clothes) so its edge fits, then run_workflow. The picture's size is the drawing's: the empty latent is no longer used. The kept character (cut out) is among the run's previews: if part of it is missing or the old background clings to it, say so; a halo at its edge: raise the GrowMask expand (6) a little.
notes: Denoise 1.0: the background is drawn anew, not changed. GrowMask lets the background reach 6 px into the character so the seam is redrawn.
